description: Structured eval definitions for the Storage Gateway Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across gateway types (S3 File Gateway with NFS, Volume Gateway cached iSCSI, SMB with Active Directory, Tape Gateway VTL, missing activation key). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: S3 File Gateway with NFS file share
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — S3 File Gateway, NFS file share, cache and upload buffer sized independently, gateway region matches S3 bucket region
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy an S3 File Gateway in us-east-1. Gateway name: prod-s3-file-gateway. Activation key: ABCDE-12345-FGHIJ-67890-KLMNO. S3 bucket: my-data-bucket (us-east-1). IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/StorageGatewayS3Role. Cache disk: 500 GB. Upload buffer disk: 300 GB. Create an NFS file share with client list 10.0.0.0/16. Default storage class S3_STANDARD. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STORAGE_GATEWAY: prod-s3-file-gateway (FILE_S3) — arn:aws:storagegateway:us-east-1:123456789012:gateway/sgw-AAAAA
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Gateway type: S3 File Gateway
  [✓] Activation: gateway RUNNING
  [✓] Gateway region: us-east-1 (matches S3 bucket region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Cache: 500 GB — allocated
  [✓] Upload buffer: 300 GB — allocated
  [✓] S3 bucket: my-data-bucket (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] File share (NFS): share → s3://my-data-bucket (clients: 10.0.0.0/16)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws storagegateway describe-gateway-information --gateway-arn <arn> --region us-east-1
  aws storagegateway list-file-shares --gateway-arn <arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Volume Gateway cached mode with iSCSI volume
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Volume Gateway cached mode, iSCSI target, cache and upload buffer allocated
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a Volume Gateway in cached mode in us-east-1. Gateway name: prod-volume-gateway. Activation key: VWXYZ-98765-QRSTU-43210-PQRSX. Cache disk: 1 TB. Upload buffer: 500 GB. Create a cached iSCSI volume of 1 TB. Target name: prod-volume-01. Network interface: eni-xxxx12345. Tags: Environment=production, Storage=cached.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STORAGE_GATEWAY: prod-volume-gateway (VOLUME) — arn:aws:storagegateway:us-east-1:123456789012:gateway/sgw-BBBBB
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Gateway type: Volume Gateway (Cached)
  [✓] Cache: 1 TB — allocated
  [✓] Upload buffer: 500 GB — allocated
  [✓] iSCSI volume: prod-volume-01 (1 TB)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws storagegateway describe-gateway-information --gateway-arn <arn> --region us-east-1
  aws storagegateway list-volumes --gateway-arn <arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SMB file share with Active Directory integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — S3 File Gateway, SMB file share, Active Directory domain join, authenticated access, audit logging
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy an S3 File Gateway in us-east-1 with an SMB file share. Gateway name: prod-smb-gateway. Activation key: ABCDE-11111-FGHIJ-22222-KLMNO. S3 bucket: smb-share-bucket (us-east-1). Join Active Directory: domain corp.example.com, OU OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com, username sgw-service. Create an authenticated SMB file share with admin user corp\sgw-admins. Enable audit logging to CloudWatch. Tags: Environment=production, Protocol=smb.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STORAGE_GATEWAY: prod-smb-gateway (FILE_S3)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Gateway type: S3 File Gateway
  [✓] Active Directory: joined (domain: corp.example.com)
  [✓] File share (SMB): authenticated (ActiveDirectory)
  [✓] Audit logging: CloudWatch Logs

eval_cases.name: Tape Gateway with VTL and Glacier tape pool
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Tape Gateway, VTL with virtual tapes, Glacier tape pool with governance retention
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a Tape Gateway in us-east-1. Gateway name: backup-tape-gateway. Activation key: TAPEK-99999-VTLXX-88888-YYYYY. Cache: 200 GB. Upload buffer: 400 GB. Create a tape pool named GlacierPool with GLACIER storage class and 365-day governance retention. Create 10 virtual tapes of 1 TB each with barcode prefix TAPE. Tags: Environment=production, Purpose=backup.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STORAGE_GATEWAY: backup-tape-gateway (VTL)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Gateway type: Tape Gateway
  [✓] Tape pool: GlacierPool (GLACIER, 365-day governance)
  [✓] Virtual tapes: 10 tapes (1 TB each, prefix TAPE)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws storagegateway describe-gateway-information --gateway-arn <arn> --region us-east-1
  aws storagegateway list-tapes --gateway-arn <arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Storage Gateway deployment without activation key (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no activation key provided; gateway cannot be activated
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy an S3 File Gateway in us-east-1. Gateway name: prod-s3-gateway. I have the gateway VM running but haven't generated the activation key yet. S3 bucket: my-bucket. Cache: 500 GB. Upload buffer: 300 GB.
eval_cases.expected_output:
STORAGE_GATEWAY: prod-s3-gateway
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Activation key: missing — gateway cannot be activated without an activation key from the gateway VM activation endpoint
